Unknown ([[JN138]]-present) | java1=[[Shin-ichiro Miki]]| java2=[[Shin-ichiro Miki]]| java3=[[Shin-ichiro Miki]]| }} '''Misty's Politoed''' (Japanese: '''カスミのニョロトノ''' ''Kasumi's Nyorotono'') was the only {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} that {{an|Misty}} {{pkmn2|caught}} in the [[Orange Islands]], and her seventh overall. ==In animation== ===History=== ===={{aniseries|OS}}==== [[File:Misty Poliwag salveyo weed.png|thumb|left|220px|Poliwag helping to collect Salveyo weed]] In ''[[EP110|The Stun Spore Detour]]'', {{Ash}} and {{Tracey}} were {{status|paralysis|paralyzed}} by a {{p|Vileplume}}'s {{m|Stun Spore}} attack. Misty was left to fetch the cure, [[Salveyo weed]], a special type of aquatic plant found at the bottom of lakes on which {{p|Poliwag}} feed. A friendly {{pkmn2|wild}} Poliwag helped her gather the special plant out of thanks for Misty protecting it from {{TRT}}. Poliwag obviously liked Misty, because it insisted on coming along with her, and Misty added it to her team. In ''[[EP113|Viva Las Lapras]]'', Poliwag was called out, along with Misty's {{TP|Misty|Goldeen}}, {{TP|Misty|Staryu}}, and [[Ash's Squirtle]], to help defeat the pirate poachers attempting to capture {{AP|Lapras}}'s mother and family. It joined the other Pokémon in destroying the pirates' cannons with its {{m|Water Gun}}. Then it gave [[Captain Crook]] a point-blank Water Gun to the face when he refused Misty's demand to call off his {{p|Tentacruel}} from their ordered attack on Ash, {{AP|Pikachu}}, and Lapras. ===={{aniseries|GS}}==== In ''[[EP151|The Totodile Duel]]'', Ash and Misty both used [[Lure Ball]]s on a wild {{AP|Totodile}}. One of the Lure Balls caught the Big Jaw Pokémon out of sight, so Ash and Misty had a tournament to see who got the {{t|Water}} type. During a battle against {{AP|Bulbasaur}}, Misty's Poliwag [[Evolution|evolved]] into {{p|Poliwhirl}}. Although Misty still lost, she concluded that she preferred the Poliwhirl who was willing to evolve to help her, rather than the Totodile who essentially did whatever he wanted. In ''[[EP157|The Fortune Hunters]]'', Poliwhirl was sent out alongside {{AP|Pikachu}} and Totodile to stop [[Butch]] and [[Cassidy]]'s fake {{pkmn|Day Care}} scheme. In ''[[EP168|Hook, Line, and Stinker]]'', Misty used Poliwhirl in the [[Seaking Catching Competition]]. During the competition, Misty and Poliwhirl formed a rivalry with [[Andreas]] and his {{p|Poliwrath}}. Poliwhirl and Misty hooked a {{p|Seaking}} just as time ran out for the competition. Andreas and Misty both had a 55-kilogram Seaking, meaning they had to battle each other to decide the winner. The battle started with Poliwhirl getting overwhelmed due to battling its evolved form. It lost its confidence and hid behind Misty. [[Misty's Psyduck]], {{TP|Misty|Staryu}}, and {{TP|Misty|Goldeen}} then popped out of their Balls to encourage Poliwhirl, and it decided to resume the match. Poliwhirl then beat Poliwrath, winning the competition for Misty. In ''[[Mewtwo Returns]]'', Poliwhirl was sent out alongside Misty and Brock's Pokémon to stop {{an|Giovanni}} and the rest of [[Team Rocket]] from recapturing {{OBP|Mewtwo|M01}}. Their distraction gave Ash the time he needed to take Mewtwo to the top of [[Mount Quena]] so it could be healed. [[File:Ash Totodile vs Misty Poliwhirl.png|thumb|220px|Poliwhirl in the Whirl Cup]] Misty used Poliwhirl in the second and third rounds of the [[Whirl Cup]] in ''[[EP217|The Perfect Match!]]''. In the second round, Poliwhirl went up against Ash's Totodile. Ash started the battle by having Totodile use Water Gun, but Poliwhirl dove underwater to evade it. Poliwhirl jumped out of the water and attacked with Bubble, dazing Totodile for a while. Poliwhirl attempted to use {{m|Double Slap}}, but Totodile dodged and headbutted it back into a pillar. However, Poliwhirl kicked off the pillar and dove towards Totodile, using Double Slap again, and [[fainting|knocking Totodile out]]. Ash recalled Totodile and sent out {{AP|Kingler}}. Misty again commanded Poliwhirl to unleash another Bubble, but Kingler used {{m|Crabhammer}} first. An energy sphere was sent across the arena, causing whirlpools to form. The attack knocked Poliwhirl into the whirlpools, and another Crabhammer attack knocked Poliwhirl out. [[File:EP247.png|thumb|left|220px|The King's Rock Poliwhirl used to evolve]] Misty again started with Poliwhirl in the third round against [[Trinity]] and her {{p|Gyarados}}. Misty told Poliwhirl to use Bubble, but Trinity responded with Gyarados's {{m|Hyper Beam}}. Gyarados quickly charged up and fired the Hyper Beam, knocking the Bubble away and defeating Poliwhirl. In ''[[EP247|Outrageous Fortunes]]'', on the way to [[Blackthorn City]], Misty fought [[Delaney|a Trainer]] with a Poliwrath and lost. Misty started to consider evolving Poliwhirl. Misty took Poliwhirl to the local [[Pokémon Center]] to be healed, with Poliwhirl picking up the [[King's Rock]] that Ash had won in a tournament on the way. Misty did not notice this and simply gave Poliwhirl to [[Nurse Joy]] for treatment. Shortly afterward, in a battle against {{TRT}}, Misty recovered her Poliwhirl via transfer machine from another Pokémon Center and let it out. It was summoned wearing the King's Rock, surprising Misty when it evolved into Politoed before her eyes. Although it wasn't the Poliwrath she wanted, Misty was thrilled with her newly evolved Pokémon. In ''[[EP249|I Politoed Ya So!]]'', Politoed was mistaken by {{OBP|Tammy|EP249}} for her Politoed, Bean. She took Politoed to her dance school and quickly figured out Politoed wasn't hers, but was impressed by its clapping and excellent rhythm. While practicing, Misty found them and insisted she be given Politoed back. Tammy believed Politoed was key to winning the National Cheering Competition and begged Misty to let her use Politoed. While deciding what to do, Team Rocket arrived to steal the dancing troupe. Politoed teamed up with Bean to send them blasting off and, finding that Bean had discovered its sense of rhythm, Tammy agreed to let Politoed return to Misty. In ''[[EP273|Gotta Catch Ya Later!]]'', Politoed defeated [[Invincible Pokémon Brothers|Kim]]'s {{p|Hitmonchan}} with Bubble, while [[Ash's Pikachu]] and [[Brock's Forretress]] handled the other brothers' Pokémon. ===={{g|Chronicles}}==== In ''[[HS02|Cerulean Blues]]'', Politoed was sent out of its Poké Ball to calm down a rampaging {{TP|Misty|Gyarados}}. ===={{aniseries|JN}}==== In ''[[JN138|A Fated Face-Off!]]'', Politoed was used in Misty's battle against Ash to decide who would get to catch a {{P|Clauncher}} they were both trying to get. Politoed battled against {{AP|Corphish}}, and after a tough battle, Politoed emerged victorious, allowing Misty to add {{TP|Misty|Clauncher}} to her team. During the battle, Misty revealed that Politoed had become the guardian deity of the [[Cerulean Gym]]. In ''[[JN141|A Squad's Worth of Passion!]]'', Politoed was called out alongside {{TP|Misty|Psyduck}} and Clauncher to help the [[Squirtle Squad]] stop a rampaging fire. ===Personality and characteristics=== [[File:Misty and Politoed.png|thumb|left|250px|Politoed and Misty]] [[File:Misty Politoed clap.png|thumb|220px|Politoed's habit of clapping]] As a {{p|Poliwag}}, it was very friendly, cheerful, and liked to help people, as shown when {{an|Misty}} first caught it in ''[[EP110|The Stun Spore Detour]]''. It was shown to be highly affectionate toward Misty even before its capture, as shown by it nuzzling up against her after Misty used some Pokémon cream on it. After it evolved into a Poliwhirl, Misty began to use it in many of her battles as it developed more stability on land. Poliwhirl, however, also had a bit of a confidence problem, where it tended to hide behind Misty's legs to avoid confrontation. In ''[[EP168|Hook, Line, and Stinker]]'', Poliwhirl overcame its fears after Misty's other Pokémon offered support. In its future battles during the [[Whirl Cup]] and against [[Delaney]], Poliwhirl leaped into the rounds with visible determination. After evolving into Politoed, it became particularly cheerful. Its habit of clapping, even at inappropriate moments or when being scolded, often irritated Misty. However, its excellent rhythm proved useful in ''[[EP249|I Politoed Ya So!]]'', where it took up cheerleading with {{OBP|Tammy|EP249}}'s Pokémon cheer squad. Tammy rekindled her interest in entertaining audiences with cheers rather than winning tournaments, while her own Politoed, [[nickname]]d Bean, learned Misty's Politoed's clap routine. Politoed also continued to show its affection toward Misty in that same episode, running joyously toward her when she had found it at Tammy's home. Since Misty stopped traveling with Ash, Politoed has become one of her most trusted Pokémon as of ''[[JN138|A Fated Face-Off!]]''. '''Sleeve images:''' {{TCGMerchGallery |background={{tcg water color}} |border={{tcg water color dark}} |image1=Misty Starmie Sleeves.jpg |caption1=Misty & Starmie Sleeves }} ==Trivia== * Poliwag is the first of Misty's Pokémon to be seen [[Evolution|evolving]] in {{aniseries|PTS}}. ** Poliwag's Evolution into Poliwhirl marked the first onscreen Evolution of any Pokémon belonging to one of {{ashfr|Ash's friends}}. ** Politoed is the only Pokémon owned by Misty in the animated series that has evolved twice. * Poliwag is the last [[Generation I]] Pokémon that a main character captured in the original series, excluding those caught and either released or given away in the same episode (such as [[Casey's Beedrill|Ash's Beedrill]] and {{DL|List of Pokémon temporarily owned by the Team Rocket trio|Victreebel|James's second Victreebel}}). * Politoed is the first Pokémon belonging to a main character that has evolved via the use of an item (in this case, a [[King's Rock]]). * Politoed has used the most [[move]]s out of all of Misty's Pokémon, with eleven total. * Politoed is Misty's first Pokémon to defeat a [[region]]al {{pkmn|Champion}}'s Pokémon, defeating [[Ash's Corphish]] in ''[[JN138|A Fated Face-Off!]]''. * Politoed is the only Pokémon in ''Pokémon the Series'' to have used the move {{m|Swagger}}. ** Although Politoed learned Swagger in ''[[EP247|Outrageous Fortunes]]'', it hasn't used the move since that episode. ==Related articles== {{Animespeciesevo2|Poliwag|Poliwhirl|Politoed}} {{Misty's Pokémon}} {{Project Anime notice|no}} [[Category:Misty's Pokémon|Politoed]] [[Category:Pokémon with animated series move errors]] [[Category:Stadium 2 characters]] [[Category:Electric Tale of Pikachu characters]] [[Category:Ash & Pikachu characters]] [[de:Mistys Quaxo]] [[es:Politoed de Misty]] [[fr:Tarpaud d'Ondine]] [[it:Politoed di Misty]] [[ja:カスミのニョロトノ]] [[zh:小霞的蚊香蛙皇]]
